quick_wins.title: Large Component Detection
quick_wins.description: UserDashboard.tsx exceeds 450 lines of code. Consider breaking into sub-components.

vulnerabilities.title: Potentially Exposed API Secret
vulnerabilities.description: Detected a string pattern matching a high-entropy secret (potential Stripe Key).
vulnerabilities.remediation: Move to environment variables and rotate the key immediately.

vulnerabilities.title: Insecure Transition in Axios
vulnerabilities.description: Outdated version of axios allows potential SSRF.

full_audit_report.ai_reasoning: The system architecture exhibits strong modularization in the UI layer but suffers from direct coupling between the Auth services and Database utilities. LangGraph agents recommend implementing a Repository Pattern to abstract data persistence.

refactor_suggestion.title: SRP Violation in Request Handler
refactor_suggestion.reasoning: The target function is handling auth, validation, and db operations simultaneously. We recommend decoupling the service layer.
